title: Chapter 296: Daxia Territory And The Allied Forces
content:
Chapter 296: Daxia Territory And The Allied Forces

Flying at the forefront of the Zerg air force were 10,000 huge five-star Zerg Devourers. Their one round of attack made the Demon air force feel very bad.

But it was too late. The strongest five-star demons in the Demon air force all flew at the front of the team and were the first to bear the attack of the Zerg Devourers. With their five-star strength, they could not stop the attack of the Zerg Devourers, which were also five-star.

Although the first round of attack by the five-star Zerg Devourers did not directly reduce the number of the five-star demons, all the five-star demons were seriously affected, and their combat power and defense were greatly reduced. Many of them were seriously injured.

Those winged demons with only one-star strength turned into light and disappeared. Many were seriously affected and began to lose the ability to fly and kept falling down.

The attacks of 10,000 five-star Zerg Devourers continued. After several rounds of attacks, the Demon air force was almost completely lost without the need for the Zerg flying dragons to attack, and even the five-star demons were no exception.

A small number of demonic demons and winged demons that were still holding on in the air were shot down one by one by the one-star Zerg flying dragons that rushed up.

Ten thousand five-star Zerg air guards continued to attack the ground. The demonic troops that rushed out of the Demonic Castle did not even have time to form a formation before they were bombed by the Zerg air guards' covering mixed explosion attack and suffered heavy losses.

When the Zerg air force advanced to the point where the five-star Zerg Devourer could attack the ground, the demonic troops in the Demonic Castle basically rushed out from other directions of the castle.

After seeing the powerful ultra-long-range firepower of the Zerg air force, the demonic army formed a loose formation to cover the long-range attack arms and rushed towards the Zerg air force.

A large number of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions began to appear in the surrounding areas of the Demonic Castle.

They are widely distributed in the territory of the demons. Around each castle where the demons gather heavy troops, there are a considerable number of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions lurking.

Facing the millions of demons with loose formations, 10,000 five-star Zerg air guards are responsible for attacking the powerful demons.

And 10,000 five-star Zerg Devourers spray terrible mucus at the vanguard of the demon army, destroying the vanguard of the demons while leaving a large amount of terrible mucus, causing the demon army rushing up from behind to be hurt and infected with special spores.

As long as it is properly controlled, every soldier of the demon army rushing over will be infected by the special spores released by the terrible mucus of the Zerg Devourer.

It happens that the Queen of Zerg is best at calculation. Under its command, 10,000 five-star Zerg Devourers exert extremely terrible ground killing power.

The demon army that was lucky enough to pass the blocking of the five-star Zerg Sky Guard and the five-star Zerg Devourer and successfully rushed to the direction of the Zerg air force basically had its combat power greatly reduced, and even the Zerg Puppies and the three-type Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion could not defeat it.

20,000 five-star Zerg ultimate soldiers were used to deal with the demon army, which was basically one-star in strength. It was a bit of a waste of talent. The attacks of the Zerg Sky Guard and the Zerg Host alone destroyed more than half of the demon army.

The remaining demon army showed various negative conditions, and many of them were severely damaged and completely lost their combat power.

At this time, a large number of Zerg Puppies and three-type Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions just arrived, and many Zerg Puppies and three-type Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions also emerged from the underground around the Demon Castle. They gathered together for the final cleanup.

The Zerg Sky Guard and the Zerg Devourer stopped attacking and entered a rest and recovery state.

Five hundred thousand one-star Zerg dragons also joined the battle, assisting the Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions on the ground to clean up the remaining demon army.

The biological bombs of the Zerg dragons, the poisonous rays of the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, and the powerful melee ability of the Zerg puppies quickly wiped out the remaining demon army whose combat power had been greatly reduced.

In a battle of this scale, the accompanying six-star Zerg troops did not take action, and the Zerg air force did not suffer any damage. In a very short time, the task of annihilating the enemy was perfectly completed.

The Zerg air force reunited and flew to the next target position according to the previous formation.

The Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions on the ground paid a small amount of casualties, annihilated the remaining enemies, and rushed to the already broken demon castle. They had to clean up the demon castle, eliminate various possible demon creatures, and sort out the spoils.

The demon castle has resources to support millions of elite demon troops, which is a considerable fortune.

Energy resources such as fire energy crystals can be directly absorbed by Zerg puppies and converted into energy resources for the system.

Other loot, high-value items can be sent back by transport hosts, and loot of average value can be left in the castle for later processing.

Or it can be handed over to the alliance to support the development of the alliance.

The second detachment of the Zerg air force continued to attack the gathering places of the elite forces of the demon tribe in the territory of the demon tribe, destroying a large number of elite forces of the demon tribe, creating conditions for the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions to completely control the territory of the demon tribe.

The Zerg's behavior is also forcing the Demons to gather their real core forces to fight a decisive battle with the Zerg army.

…

In the border area between the Zerg territory and the Demon territory in the forbidden land, there were originally many Demon castles and cities that were captured by the Zerg.

Those castles were directly abandoned after being occupied by the Zerg. There were originally many people under the rule of the Demons in those cities. These people suffered all kinds of torture from the Demons. Fortunately, they were not forced to believe in evil gods. Those with strong spiritual will still have hope of being rescued.

Wu Qing put on a simplified version of the identity card for these people, and the Queen of the Zerg used the simplified version of the identity card to give them mental treatment.

After the Queen of the Zerg's continuous experiments and efforts, most people got rid of the influence of the Demons and returned to normal life.

In the former Demon territory of the forbidden land, the Zerg rescued a large number of people of various races. These people were originally tools to provide various emotional energies for the Demons.

There are many people with extremely strong wills among them. These people were recruited by Wu Cong into the army of Daxia and became the reserve army.

They practiced the Nine Transformations of the Silkworm and equipped themselves with Zerg biological equipment. After a period of training, the best of them could join the army of Daxia and become formal cavalry or infantry.

The reason why Wu Cong wanted to add an infantry branch in addition to the Daxia cavalry was that some races were really not suitable for cavalry. They could not find suitable mounts, let alone riding horses.

For the convenience of management, Daxia's cavalry only had one mount, the Zerg warhorse. The Zerg warhorse, which was powerful and did not require logistical supplies, was not comparable to other mounts.

Wu Cong organized all the races suitable for riding warhorses into Daxia cavalry, and all other races into Daxia infantry.

Wu Cong recruited and reorganized the troops, expanding the strength of Daxia's army to a million-level scale, taking a big step forward.

Under the leadership of Wu Cong, the millions of Daxia troops had already gathered in the city near the second Zerg sub-base, training while waiting for the opportunity to enter the demon territory.

In the surrounding areas of the Daxia army gathering place, there is a joint army of the alliance's territories with a strength of tens of millions.

Meng, Hu Wei, Hu Tu and others have completed the internal integration of the alliance and formulated more complete rules and regulations. The alliance has now entered the free land of the south through various means.

The integrated alliance occupies at least half of the territory and population within the original Tengu and Naga tribes, which can be regarded as having a certain foundation.

With the strong support of Wu Qing, the army of the alliance has undergone a complete transformation.

The Tiancan Jiubian Gongfa and the Zerg biological colonization suit have become the standard equipment of the army of each territories of the alliance. Except for the difference in the quality of their soldiers and the Daxia army, everything else is not bad.

The integrated alliance army, led by Meng, Hu Wei, Hu Tu, Shi Gan, Yu Chong, Bai Yan and others, gathered in a city near the second Zerg sub-base for training and standby.

The Zerg Puppies and Type III Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions have occupied a large area of the Demon Tribe territory. They only need to wait for the Zerg Air Force Second Detachment to eliminate the elite troops assembled by the Demon Tribe, and then the Daxia Territory Army and the Alliance Army can enter the Demon Tribe territory.

The Demon Tribe territory, which only has ordinary troops left, has become an excellent place for military trials. Soldiers with the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations and Zerg biological colonization equipment can improve their strength at a very fast speed in such trials.

After this trial, Daxia Territory and the Alliance will have their own powerful army.

Of course, the army that has practiced the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations and equipped with Zerg biological colonization equipment is Wu Qing's army.

The Zerg Air Force Second Detachment cleared all the gathering points of the Demon Tribe's elite troops close to the Zerg Second Base, and a relatively safe trial area was built.

At Wu Qing's order, the Daxia Territory Army and the Alliance Army, who had been impatient for a long time, went straight into the Demon Tribe territory.

Under the guidance of the Queen, they attacked the castles, cities and gathering places of the demon clan.

The Daxia army and the alliance army, depending on the strength of the target, either gathered together to besiege, or dispersed to pursue and encircle, or cooperated with the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, and continuously carried out high-intensity marches and battles.

After being tempered by the demon clan army, the Daxia army and the alliance army gradually tempered into two strong armies.

Wu Qing also has two armies that can fight in addition to the Zerg army, and the future of these two armies is promising.
